language_detection.detector: unicode-script + devanagari word/2-5-suffix model (char n-gram fallback)
language_detection.note: English/Bengali/Gujarati/Tamil/Telugu/Kannada are deterministic script-range checks; only the Devanagari (hi/mr) disambiguation is learned (words + 2-5-char suffixes, multinomial NB with Laplace smoothing, plus language-marker characters and a char n-gram fallback). The Devanagari model is trained on the held-out-even split, so its F1 is an honest generalization estimate; the production detector trains on the full curated set. Related-language confusions (hi/mr) appear in the confusion matrix.

retrieval.note: Glossary sizes (terms per language): {'bengali': 15, 'gujarati': 15, 'hindi': 15, 'kannada': 15, 'marathi': 15, 'tamil': 15, 'telugu': 15}. Because each glossary is small, perfect Recall@1/MRR is trivially reachable; treat these as sanity numbers, not evidence of strong retrieval on open vocabulary.

translation_memory.note: Semantic hits require the sentence-transformer encoder (downloads on first use). Without it, only exact matches are served from the TM.

throughput.note: Live mode: real ModelRegistry inference. Numbers are single-machine and depend on the installed models.

translations.source: I would like to order two cups of tea and some snacks.

translations.source: The database query returned results in under fifty milliseconds.
